newsitem.title: USA: HFS and PHH closer to merger.
newsitem.headline: HFS and PHH closer to merger.

text.p: HFS Inc and PHH Corp said on Wednesday that PHH shareholders will receive a ratio of 0.825 shares of HFS stock for each share of PHH stock in the projected merger agreement between the two companies.

The company simultaneously announced the completion of the pricing period for determining the exchange ratio in connection with the proposed merger. The pricing period was completed at the close of trading on the NYSE on Tuesday, they said.
The average closing price of HFS stock for the twenty trading days that ended at the close was $56.813, they added.
HFS anticipates issuing up to 30.9 million shares, including shares issued to holders of PHH employee stock options, at the close of the merger.
A shareholder vote for both HFS and PHH is scheduled for April 30, which is the anticipated closing date of the transaction, the companies said.
They also said that HFS shareholders of record as of March 3, and PHH shareholders of record as of Jan. 31, are entitled to vote on the merger.
HFS Inc is a consumer services company that franchises hotels and residential real estate brokerage offices, and owns Avis Inc rental car system.
PHH delivers outsourcing services in the areas of vehicle leasing and fleet management, as well as employee relocation services.
